factProposals.value: Two human roles use the app: Reviewer (works the Review Queue, reviewer page and Rules page) and Admin (everything a reviewer can, plus adding, removing and changing the role of reviewers and admins). Anyone else is refused at sign-in.

Reviewers and admins sign in through Basecamp Launchpad OAuth (authorization code, then authorization.json for the person's identity and accounts), using a second Basecamp integration separate from the one that posts feedback.

Every page and API except /health and /auth/* requires a signed-in session; without one, pages redirect to sign-in and APIs answer 401 before anything is read or changed. Admin-only actions answer 403 to a Reviewer.

Sessions last a fixed 8 hours from sign-in and end at once on sign-out; the browser holds a random token in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax cookie and the server keeps only its SHA-256 hash. The person's Basecamp token is used once and never stored.
The reviewer/admin list (Basecamp email, role, who changed it, when) is kept in the app's own git-ignored storage, not SQL Server; fixed admins come from server configuration.
Only an admin can grant or remove access; every role change, sign-in, refusal and sign-out is written to the audit trail with who and when.

decisions.statement: People are matched on their Basecamp email, not their Basecamp person id.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-10-01: admins add people by an address they know

decisions.statement: The first admins come from AUTH_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAILS and cannot be removed or demoted in the app; the last admin can never be removed.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-10-01: the role list must never lock every admin out

decisions.statement: Sign-in uses a second Basecamp integration with its own client id and redirect URI, separate from the posting app.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-10-01: the posting app's registration and token stay untouched

decisions.statement: Every API except /health and /auth/* requires sign-in, including the older intake and check endpoints; intake (it changes the Review Queue) is admin-only.
decisions.rationale: user decision 2026-10-01: the simplest rule to reason about; a test sweeps every route in the OpenAPI schema

decisions.statement: The temporary X-Reviewer-Id header was removed from the review, queue, rules and posting routes and pages; the reviewer is the signed-in email.
decisions.rationale: user approved changing the STORY-005/006/012 files, 2026-10-01

decisions.statement: A request with no session is logged, not written to the audit trail.
decisions.rationale: otherwise anyone could fill the audit file without signing in; sign-ins, refusals, sign-outs, role changes and admin refusals are audited

limitations.statement: The live Basecamp sign-in has not been tried: it needs the second Basecamp integration registered and its settings in .env. Everything is verified against a fake Launchpad.
Sessions are held in server memory: a restart signs everyone out, and several server processes would not share sessions.
Signing out of Basecamp does not end this app's session; it ends at sign-out here or after 8 hours.
Real posting to Basecamp is still switched off (BASECAMP_POSTING_ENABLED=no) and there is no Post button, although sign-in, its precondition, now exists.
